function mountCoverPlayer(r,test){return(function(r,test){var Q=function(d){return r.querySelector('[data-'+d+']')},m=Q('media'),f=Q('file'),c=Q('rights'),P=Q('play'),S=Q('pause'),R=Q('reveal'),T=Q('status'),g={},u,n=0,F,G=function(t,x){x=x||{};x.type=t;g=coverGate(g,x)},U=function(s){T.textContent=s||(g.revealed?'':'Requirements not met/configured');f.disabled=!c.checked;P.disabled=S.disabled=!g.allowed||!F;R.disabled=!g.allowed||!F||F.type.indexOf('video/');m.hidden=!g.revealed},rst=function(){n++;m.pause();m.removeAttribute('src');m.load();u&&URL.revokeObjectURL(u);u=F=0;G('select',{allowed:!1});m.hidden=!0},pause=function(){m.pause();G('pause');U()},check=function(){G('check',{predicate:test,facts:{file:F}});U();return g};c.onchange=function(){c.checked||rst();U()};f.onchange=function(){var x=f.files&&f.files[0],ok=c.checked&&x&&/^(audio|video)\//.test(x.type);rst();ok&&(F=x,u=URL.createObjectURL(x),m.src=u,G('select',{id:x.name,allowed:!0}));U()};P.onclick=function(){if(!g.allowed||!F)return;var k=++n,p;G('play');p=m.play();p&&p.catch&&p.catch(function(e){k==n&&(pause(),U(e&&e.message||'error'))})};S.onclick=pause;R.onclick=function(){if(!F||F.type.indexOf('video/'))return;G('check',{predicate:test,facts:{file:F}});G('reveal');U()};document.onvisibilitychange=function(){document.hidden&&pause()};onpagehide=rst;U();return{pause:pause,check:check,media:m}})(r,test||function(){return!1})}
